answer: A concrete sybil defense is a funding-source quota with random audits: each wallet cluster may register only a few identities per epoch, and a public beacon picks a share of new identities to re-prove independent control or forfeit their bond. A farm's linked accounts form an island on the funding graph, and every extra clone needs a fresh bond, so cost grows with each fake. An honest agent pays the base bond once, while the delta between honest and cloned behavior stays easy to measure.
